senses.gloss: f. (ἀπαντή = ἀπάντησις) encountering.—לא׳ (= εἰς ἀπαντήν, h. לקראת) to meet, to receive. Tanḥ. Emor 22 לא׳ של טלך to salute the king. Pesik. R. Ten Command. 1 לא׳ של מלך וכ׳ (some ed. לאנפטי, corr. acc.) to salute his father the king.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12:2">Cant. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>לאפנתי</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:4:7">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>לפגטי</he>; Midr. Sam. ch. VII <he>לאפרכי דידיה</he> (corr. acc., or Var. <he>לאפי</he>). [<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1058">Yalk. Esth. 1058</cite> <he>לאנפטי</he> some ed., read: <cite ref="A02093"><he>אַנְבְּטֵי</he></cite>.]
